correctness.rationale: The explicit formula separates the finitely many conditioned primes with an O(1/log X) contribution. Hence the support exponents remain exactly those of Ahlquist's proof. The 75% deduction is then an exact test-function calculation using even central multiplicity.

value.rationale: Local splitting conditions are a standard way to isolate arithmetically meaningful cubic-field subfamilies. The predecessor theorem achieves support only <2/5 there, while support <1 is the threshold that, together with even root number, yields a positive 75% nonvanishing proportion. Preserving the new support through fixed local conditioning is therefore a substantive strengthening, not a cosmetic restatement or finite computation.
